name: 小鸭
algorithm: visibility-aware calibrated photos + SLIC + weighted view fusion + Lab groups + edge-aware ICM

photo_refinement.method: edge-aware Potts ICM + conservative small island merge

settings.dark_seed_rule: L < 37 OR contrast > 22, after contrast > 12 and L < 43
settings.accent_rule: a > 10, b < 20, L > 35, a-b > 7; measured RGB only
settings.mesh_optimizer: ICM, 12 bounded passes; not graph cuts
